answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each new identity pays a one-time tax equal to 20 days of expected earnings, burned on entry and logged on a ledger as clear as crystal, so nothing hides. This is no fable: creating 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 taxes, or 20,000 days of earnings, for diluted rewards, like bees crowding one flower for its nectar. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards, so honesty is cheap and fakery never pays.
